_schema.purpose: DATA CONTRACT for the PDF -> chunks -> embeddings worked-example animation (timeline.js sequences, process-anim.js renders).

shape.doc: Source document payload: { id, title, text } -- the PDF text being processed.
shape.chunks: Ordered chunk list produced by the split step: [{ id, fromChar, toChar, text }]. fromChar/toChar index into doc.text.
shape.vectors: Vector stubs produced by the embed step: [{ id, chunkId, dim, values[] }]. values[] is a SHORT placeholder (e.g. first few dims) -- not a real embedding.
shape.steps: Ordered animation steps. Each: { id, kind, caption, targets, duration }.

step.id: string -- unique step id, defines play order by array position
step.caption: string shown in .timeline__caption while the step is active
step.targets: string[] -- ids this step acts on (chunk ids for split/embed, vector ids for store)
step.duration: number -- milliseconds the step animation runs (timeline.js may scale by speed; reduced-motion snaps to end)

rules: steps are played in array order; targets must reference existing chunk/vector ids
kind split targets chunks; embed targets chunks producing vectors; store targets vectors
animate transform/opacity only; reduced-motion jumps to end state
values[] are stubs for layout only -- cookbook-author/interactive-engineer may replace with real but small samples
underscore-prefixed keys (like _schema) are metadata and MUST be skipped by consumers

doc.title: Kak rabotaet RAG (ishodnyj dokument)
doc.text: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) podmeshivaet vneshnie dokumenty v zapros k LLM. Korpus razrezayut na chunki; kazhdyj chunk prevrashchayut v vektor (embedding). Vektory hranyat v indekse i ishchut blizhajshie k zaprosu pered generaciej otveta.

chunks.text: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) podmeshivaet vneshnie dokumenty v zapros k LLM.
Korpus razrezayut na chunki; kazhdyj chunk prevrashchayut v vektor (embedding).
Vektory hranyat v indekse i ishchut blizhajshie k zaprosu pered generaciej otveta.

steps.caption: Shag 1: rezhem dokument na chunki po granicam predlozhenij.
Shag 2: kazhdyj chunk prevrashchaem v vektor (embedding) fiksirovannoj dliny dim=1536.
Shag 3: kladem vektory v indeks dlya poiska blizhajshih k zaprosu.
